name: Nested install by default
objective: Make the nested personal install the installer's default layout everywhere (existing repos and fresh dirs, which get git init + nested workflow/); the at-root layout only on --at-root (or --into-existing); --update auto-detects the installed layout from its marker so /update-workspace needs no --nested; existing at-root installs keep updating at-root with no migration; ship as v50.

review.note: nested install is the default (git init for new/empty targets), --at-root for the committed layout, --update detects layout; smoke 235/0; at-root identical to v49 behind --at-root; D42-D45 filed

acceptance.walkthrough: Scratch walkthrough (~5 min, throwaway dir): B=<repo>/bootstrap_agentic_workspace.sh; T=$(mktemp -d); cd "$T". (1) sh "$B" new/proj -> installs privately, host git-inited, convention confirmed; in new/proj: ls -A shows .claude .git CLAUDE.local.md workflow, git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all is empty, python3 workflow/scripts/workflow.py next shows no UNCONFIRMED. (2) sh "$B" new/proj --update --dry-run and --update --nested --dry-run -> both "(nested, detected)". (3) sh "$B" ar --at-root -> committed layout, no workflow/; sh "$B" ar --update --dry-run stays at-root; bare sh "$B" ar -> refuses "use --update", exit 1. (4) Refusals writing nothing: sh "$B" x --force-empty-ok; a non-empty non-git dir; sh "$B" new/proj/sub/x (inside another repo). Decision D1 (operator question): a new dir inside another repo work tree is refused (recommended: keep; escape is git init <dir>) or auto-init? Frictions W1-W4 are filed as deferred jobs. Clear with: accept-gate P29 --clear.
acceptance.note: operator accepted without a walkthrough run; will report problems from real use. D1: no answer given, current refusal stands
